cutoff_rule: For a bout on date D, every feature must be computed only from observations with event_date < D.
forbidden: Current 2026 career aggregates backfilled into historical bouts
Any fight/result/stat occurring on or after the target bout date
Current UFC.com aggregate metrics used as if they existed historically
allowed: Historical bout-level UFCStats/DWCS technical rows dated before the target bout
Historical odds snapshots/open-close data for the target bout
Regional career history dated before the target bout
DOB-derived age calculated on the target bout date
Physical attributes with source provenance and no post-bout transformation

example.fighter_2023: 2023 snapshot uses only fights/stats known before the 2023 DWCS bout.
example.fighter_2026: 2026 snapshot may additionally use valid 2023-2025 tracked fights that occurred before the 2026 bout.
